# Turn an Upwork transaction history into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free Upwork to QuickBooks and Xero journal converter: books hourly, fixed-price and bonus earnings gross, Upwork service fees and Connects as expenses, checks the running balance for missing rows, splits by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
